build_linear_interpolation: build a python module that computes linear interpolation utilities for normalized point offsets using _linear_interpolation_utilities
create_bilinear_interpolation_helper: create a BilinearInterpolationHelper from packed annotations and output resolution using the from_matches static method
extract_values_with_bilinear_interpolati: extract estimated values at annotation points using BilinearInterpolationHelper extract_at_points with bilinear interpolation weights
resample_tensor_data_between_bboxes: resample tensor data from source bounding boxes to destination bounding boxes using resample_data with grid sampling
